{{Top|leg}}
A '''planetary scanner array''' was a large, multistory complex structure. The structure could take several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to build, and required around a hundred sentients or [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to build it.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
